title: Autocomplete search component
body:
Hi,

I'm looking for a way to display suggestions on a search field, I saw that you have a autocomplete.js library but it looks outdated. I saw that there is a connectAutocomplete connector in instantsearch.js but the documentation about how to implement it is also outdated (404 links).

Do you have any examples of a implementation of an angular 2+ / ssr / autocomplete search ?

Thanks !

comments.body:
Which links are 404ing? 

the documentation of conenctAutocomplete are here: https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/v2/connectors/connectAutocomplete.html

The way to use it would be just like this guide: https://community.algolia.com/angular-instantsearch/guides/customize-widgets.html

but instead with a component that does the visual display of a dropdown list (like https://material.angular.io/components/autocomplete/overview)

@Haroenv 

About the broken links:

here: https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/blob/c18e170333b8f557d542c7c383c9c09464c71607/src/connectors/autocomplete/connectAutocomplete.js#L16

here: https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/blob/c18e170333b8f557d542c7c383c9c09464c71607/src/connectors/autocomplete/connectAutocomplete.js#L47

the first link here: https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/v2/connectors/connectAutocomplete.html
I think that the second link now refers to: https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/blob/a3821cf44ef72b7fcc806b9e3a457da4d72fd83f/dev/app/jquery/stories/autocomplete.stories.js.

The link was fixed in the code. You can see the new documentation on the [Algolia website](https://www.algolia.com/doc/api-reference/widgets/autocomplete/js/).

We wrote a [guide for Angular InstantSearch](https://www.algolia.com/doc/guides/building-search-ui/resources/ui-and-ux-patterns/in-depth/autocomplete/angular/) to leverage this connector.
